prompts.title: Loose watercolor painting of anything
prompts.tool: Any image AI (ChatGPT / Gemini / Midjourney / Grok)
prompts.prompt: Abstract watercolor wash of a [subject], loose oversized brushstrokes, broad flowing color shapes, minimal detail, soft pigment bleeding, expressive wet-on-wet texture, simplified forms, airy composition, no linework, no outlines, white background
prompts.why: Swap [subject] for a pet, city or object. 'No linework, no outlines' is what stops the AI from drawing a cartoon and keeps it looking like real wet paint.
prompts.author: @azed_ai

prompts.title: Paper cut-out storybook character
prompts.tool: Any image AI (ChatGPT / Gemini / Midjourney / Grok)
prompts.prompt: Paper cut-out animation of a [subject] [simple action], full-body character, layered paper shapes, handmade paper texture, visible cut edges, soft shadows between layers, flat colorful paper tones, slightly imperfect handcrafted details, minimal paper-collage scenery, charming folk story aesthetic, gentle stop-motion feel, poetic children’s book atmosphere, clean white background
prompts.why: Fill in two blanks, e.g. 'a fox' + 'reading a book'. 'Visible cut edges' and 'soft shadows between layers' sell the handmade paper look.
prompts.author: @azed_ai

prompts.title: Cinematic 3D fantasy character
prompts.tool: Any image AI (ChatGPT / Gemini / Midjourney / Grok)
prompts.prompt: A cinematic 3D full-body render of [fantasy character], wearing [armor design] assembled from salvaged robotic parts, [facial features], [hairstyle], carrying [weapon], distressed fabrics, corroded metal plating, exposed mechanisms, intricate mechanical details, battle-worn appearance, realistic PBR textures, stylized realism, dramatic studio lighting, Unreal Engine 5 quality, clean white background
prompts.why: Fill the five blanks (e.g. an elf knight, a samurai helmet, a long bow). The material words like corroded metal and PBR textures are what make it look like a game render instead of a cartoon.
prompts.author: @azed_ai

prompts.title: Expressive ink wash painting
prompts.tool: Any image AI (ChatGPT / Gemini / Midjourney / Grok)
prompts.prompt: An expressive traditional ink wash painting of [subject], featuring [distinctive details], [pose or action], flowing black ink, delicate gray washes, organic brushstrokes, dramatic ink bleeding, subtle watercolor diffusion, textured rice paper, minimalist composition, elegant negative space, traditional sumi-e aesthetics, handcrafted artistic imperfections, clean white background
prompts.why: Fill [subject], details and pose. 'Ink bleeding' + 'sumi-e' keep it painterly; 'clean white background' stops busy scenery from eating the brushwork.
prompts.author: @azed_ai

prompts.title: Stop-motion movie character
prompts.tool: Any image AI (ChatGPT / Gemini / Midjourney / Grok)
prompts.prompt: A highly detailed 3D stop-motion animated movie character design of [character], [age], [cultural background], featuring [body proportions], [distinctive facial features], [hairstyle], [facial expression], wearing [outfit] with [fabric textures and details], [footwear], standing in [pose] with a charming, expressive personality, stylized cartoon facial proportions combined with realistic anatomy, distinctive character silhouette, slightly exaggerated features, playful imperfections, intricate fabric fibers, realistic material wear, rich tactile textures, handcrafted puppet aesthetic, sophisticated material layering, original animated film character design, cinematic 3D rendering, soft studio lighting, full-body composition, clean white background
prompts.why: Lots of blanks, but 'handcrafted puppet aesthetic' and 'playful imperfections' are what sell the stop-motion look instead of smooth CGI.
prompts.author: @azed_ai

prompts.title: Pixar-style 3D character reinterpretation
prompts.tool: Any image AI (ChatGPT / Gemini / Midjourney / Grok)
prompts.prompt: A premium Pixar-style 3D reinterpretation of [Samurai Jack character], preserving the iconic character design, recognizable facial features, signature hairstyle, [distinctive outfit], [weapon or accessory], [facial expression], [dynamic pose], stylized angular proportions translated into rounded yet sculptural 3D forms, expressive animated facial features, realistic skin textures, detailed fabric materials, cinematic character lighting, high-end 3D animation rendering, polished textures, full-body composition, isolated on a pure white background
prompts.why: Swap the bracketed character for any flat/2D design you love. 'Angular proportions translated into rounded yet sculptural 3D forms' is the key phrase that keeps the original silhouette while going Pixar-round.
prompts.author: @azed_ai

prompts.title: Expressive Chinese ink (Qi Baishi-style)
prompts.tool: Any image AI (ChatGPT / Gemini / Midjourney / Grok)
prompts.prompt: A colorful Chinese ink painting of [subject], inspired by Qi Baishi's expressive brushwork, minimalist abstract composition, bold continuous brushstrokes, thick expressive ink lines, vibrant watercolor accents, exaggerated anatomy, [dramatic pose], [satirical facial expression], animated cartoon personality, playful distortion, dynamic perspective, humorous philosophical undertones, traditional Chinese freehand painting aesthetic, visible ink bleeding, organic brush textures, expressive movement, generous negative space, pure white background
prompts.why: Name a subject and a satirical expression. Qi Baishi + 'playful distortion' pushes bold ink comedy instead of a stiff textbook ink wash.
prompts.author: @azed_ai

prompts.title: Fluffy toothy 3D monster
prompts.tool: Any image AI (ChatGPT / Gemini / Midjourney / Grok)
prompts.prompt: An adorable little fluffy 3D animated movie monster with a [body shape] body completely covered in thick, ultra-soft, plush [fur color] fur, realistic individual hair strands, dense velvety fluff, huge expressive [eye color] eyes, tiny legs, short furry arms, [unique features], an enormous smiling mouth filled with many perfectly clean, shiny white teeth, [facial expression], [playful pose], exaggerated cartoon proportions, innocent mischievous personality, irresistibly cuddly appearance, premium animated movie character design, detailed fur grooming, realistic subsurface lighting, soft studio illumination, full-body render, isolated on a pure white background
prompts.why: Pick body shape, fur color and eye color. The huge clean teeth + tiny legs combo is what makes it cute-scary instead of a generic furry blob.
